# @workspacekit/docx

> A Word renderer for the file workspace: .docx files laid out in pages by docx-preview and sanitized before they are shown.

- API reference: https://adityazero4.github.io/workspacekit/api/docx
- Install: `npm install @workspacekit/docx @workspacekit/react react react-dom`

## README sections

- Install
- Entry: `docxRenderer()` returns a renderer.
- Standalone use: `DocxViewer` shows one file without a tree or a provider.
- CSS: Import `@workspacekit/react/styles.css` and `@workspacekit/docx/styles.css` once each.
- Options: `classNames`: classes for this package's `docx-*` parts.
- Vite: No configuration is needed in a build or in the dev server.

## Entry points

- `@workspacekit/docx`
- `@workspacekit/docx/styles.css` (stylesheet)

## Exports of `@workspacekit/docx`

- `DOCX_MAX_BYTES`: The largest `.docx` the renderer and the standalone `DocxViewer` open: 25 MiB.
- `DOCX_PARTS`: Every element this package renders carries `data-fs-part="<part>"`; these are its part names, all with the `docx-` prefix.
- `DocxClassNames`: Extra class names per part of this package, merged after the part's own class.
- `DocxPart`: A part name of this package.
- `DocxRendererOptions`: Options of `docxRenderer`.
- `DocxViewer`: Shows a Word `.docx` without a `FileSystemProvider`, laid out in pages and sanitized like the registry entry (see `docxRenderer`).
- `DocxViewerProps`: Props of `DocxViewer`: the standalone viewer props, with this package's parts in `classNames`.
- `docxRenderer`: Creates the registry entry for Word `.docx` files up to 25 MiB, laid out in pages by docx-preview and sanitized before it is shown: no scripts, frames or embedded HTML, only `http(s):` and `mailto:` links (opened in a new tab), `#bookmark` links that scroll inside the document, no request for anything outside the file, and nothing drawn outside the viewer's box.
